build_task_template: build a PHyRE task template using @define_task_template decorator with ball_x and target_x parameters
add_dynamic_ball: create two dynamic balls in the scene using C.add with scale and center_x properties
add_static_bar: build static bar obstacles using C.add with angle and bottom positioning parameters
update_task_relationships: set task relationships using C.update_task with body1 body2 and TOUCHING spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: assign the BALL solution tier to the task using C.set_meta with SolutionTier enum
